scripts.test: vitest run && node test/token-tool.spec.mjs && vitest run -c vitest.live.config.ts

XAI_API_KEY.description: xAI API key for fast spoken answers. Create it in the xAI console.

ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.description: ElevenLabs API key for speech-to-text and text-to-speech.

REPLY_SECRET.description: Long random string (>= 16 characters). Your agent uses it as a Bearer token on POST /bloco/reply. Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32`. Never put this value in routine or agent instructions.

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Long random string (>= 16 characters) that protects pairing-code and revoke admin routes. Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32`.

WEBHOOK_URL.description: Optional HTTPS URL for agent hand-off (Grok Bot routine, OpenClaw, or any webhook).

WEBHOOK_TOKEN.description: Optional Bearer token for the agent webhook.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Optional. Only needed for a *private* memory repository. Public repos are read without a token.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional. Used when ROUTINE_PROVIDER=openai (any OpenAI-compatible base URL).
